verdict.rationale: No downloadable spec was found: every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path tried returned 404. Still, the per-endpoint API reference pages are served as machine-readable markdown with embedded OpenAPI-style YAML schema fragments (e.g. typed `triggers` enums), and the docs are indexed via llms.txt, so agents can parse the spec piecemeal. Missing for 10: a single downloadable OpenAPI/JSON spec file at a documented URL, first-party docs pointing to such a spec, and independent confirmation of spec completeness.
